<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_LuxuryAirplane"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/luxury-airplane">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Specifications" name="Airplane specifications"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_TestProtocol" name="Test protocol"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DeliveredAirplane" name="Delivered airplane"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DeliveryConfirmation" name="Delivery confirmation"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_LuxuryAirplane">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Producer" name="Airplane producer" processRef="Process_Producer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Specifications" name="Send specifications" sourceRef="Task_SendSpecifications" targetRef="Start_ReceiveSpecifications" messageRef="Message_Specifications"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_TestProtocol" name="Send test protocol" sourceRef="Task_SendTestProtocol" targetRef="Task_ReceiveTestProtocol" messageRef="Message_TestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DeliveredAirplane" name="Deliver airplane" sourceRef="Task_DeliverAirplane" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAirplane" messageRef="Message_DeliveredAirplane"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DeliveryConfirmation" name="Send delivery confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" messageRef="Message_DeliveryConfirmation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Producer" name="Produce luxury airplane" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Producer">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Coordination" name="Production coordination">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_ReceiveSpecifications</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DistributeRequirements</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ManufacturingSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ManufacturingJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssembleInterior</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TestFlight</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreateTestProtocol</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendTestProtocol</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DeliverAirplane</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_ProductionComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_RussianTeam" name="Russian team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ManufactureVodkaBar</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_IrishTeam" name="Irish team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ManufactureWhiskeyBar</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_OtherTeams" name="Other manufacturing teams">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ManufactureOtherParts</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ReceiveSpecifications" name="Receive specifications">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Specifications" messageRef="Message_Specifications"/>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DistributeRequirements" name="Send requirements to manufacturing teams">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ManufacturingSplit" name="Route requirements to relevant teams">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P4</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ManufactureVodkaBar" name="Manufacture vodka bar">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ManufactureWhiskeyBar" name="Manufacture whiskey bar">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ManufactureOtherParts" name="Manufacture other specified parts and any other selected bar">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ManufacturingJoin" name="Collect manufactured parts">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleInterior" name="Assemble airplane interior">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestFlight" name="Conduct test flight">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateTestProtocol" name="Create test protocol during flight">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTestProtocol" name="Send test protocol to customer" messageRef="Message_TestProtocol">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DeliverAirplane" name="Deliver airplane to customer" messageRef="Message_DeliveredAirplane">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" name="Receive delivery confirmation" messageRef="Message_DeliveryConfirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ProductionComplete" name="Airplane delivery confirmed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P15</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P1" sourceRef="Start_ReceiveSpecifications" targetRef="Task_DistributeRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P2" sourceRef="Task_DistributeRequirements" targetRef="Gateway_ManufacturingSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P3" sourceRef="Gateway_ManufacturingSplit" targetRef="Task_ManufactureVodkaBar">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">barType = 'vodka'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P4" sourceRef="Gateway_ManufacturingSplit" targetRef="Task_ManufactureWhiskeyBar">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">barType = 'whiskey'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P5" sourceRef="Gateway_ManufacturingSplit" targetRef="Task_ManufactureOtherParts">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P6" sourceRef="Task_ManufactureVodkaBar" targetRef="Gateway_ManufacturingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P7" sourceRef="Task_ManufactureWhiskeyBar" targetRef="Gateway_ManufacturingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P8" sourceRef="Task_ManufactureOtherParts" targetRef="Gateway_ManufacturingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P9" sourceRef="Gateway_ManufacturingJoin" targetRef="Task_AssembleInterior"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P10" sourceRef="Task_AssembleInterior" targetRef="Task_TestFlight"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P11" sourceRef="Task_TestFlight" targetRef="Task_CreateTestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P12" sourceRef="Task_CreateTestProtocol" targetRef="Task_SendTestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P13" sourceRef="Task_SendTestProtocol" targetRef="Task_DeliverAirplane"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P14" sourceRef="Task_DeliverAirplane" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P15" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" targetRef="End_ProductionComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Configure and receive luxury airplane" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Customer" name="Begin airplane configuration">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChooseSpecifications" name="Choose one of five bar options, seat count, color and toilet water amount">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSpecifications" name="Send specifications to producer" messageRef="Message_Specifications">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveTestProtocol" name="Receive test protocol" messageRef="Message_TestProtocol">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveAirplane" name="Receive delivered airplane" messageRef="Message_DeliveredAirplane">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Confirm delivery" messageRef="Message_DeliveryConfirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Customer" name="Delivery confirmed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C6</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C1" sourceRef="Start_Customer" targetRef="Task_ChooseSpecifications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C2" sourceRef="Task_ChooseSpecifications" targetRef="Task_SendSpecifications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C3" sourceRef="Task_SendSpecifications" targetRef="Task_ReceiveTestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C4" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveTestProtocol" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAirplane"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C5" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveAirplane" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C6" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="End_Customer"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

  <bpmn:message id="Message_DeliveryConfirmation" name="Delivery confirmation"/>

      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_RussianTeam" name="Russian team">

      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_OtherManufacturingTeams" name="Other manufacturing teams">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DistributeRequirements" name="Send requirements to manufacturing teams">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P1</bpmn:incoming>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P2</bpmn:incoming>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P4</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BarSelection" name="Select the specified bar option">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P18</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleInterior" name="Assemble airplane interior">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P18</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P19</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_TestParallelSplit" name="Conduct flight and prepare protocol">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P20</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P12" sourceRef="Task_ManufactureBarOption3" targetRef="Gateway_BarMerge"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BarChoice" name="Route selected bar for manufacture" default="Flow_P7">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P5</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P6</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ManufactureVodkaBar" name="Manufacture vodka bar">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ManufactureWhiskeyBar" name="Manufacture whiskey bar">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ManufactureOtherBar" name="Manufacture selected bar (one of the other three options)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BarMerge" name="Merge bar manufacturing alternatives">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ManufactureOtherParts" name="Manufacture other specified parts">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ManufacturingJoin" name="Collect manufactured parts">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleInterior" name="Assemble airplane interior">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_TestSplit" name="Conduct flight and create protocol during flight">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P15</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P16</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductTestFlight" name="Conduct test flight">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P17</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateTestProtocol" name="Create test protocol during flight">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P18</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ProtocolSplit" name="Send test protocol to both recipients">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P18</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P19</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P20</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideProtocolToProducer" name="Provide test protocol to producer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P19</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P21</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTestProtocolToCustomer" name="Send test protocol to customer" messageRef="Message_TestProtocol">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P20</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P22</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ProtocolJoin" name="Complete protocol delivery to both recipients">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P21</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P22</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P23</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_TestJoin" name="Complete flight and protocol work">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P23</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P24</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DeliverAirplane" name="Deliver airplane to customer" messageRef="Message_DeliveredAirplane">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P24</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P25</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" name="Receive delivery confirmation" messageRef="Message_DeliveryConfirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P25</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_P26</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ProductionComplete" name="Delivery confirmed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_P26</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P1" sourceRef="Start_ReceiveSpecifications" targetRef="Task_DistributeRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P2" sourceRef="Task_DistributeRequirements" targetRef="Gateway_ManufacturingSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P3" sourceRef="Gateway_ManufacturingSplit" targetRef="Gateway_BarChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P4" sourceRef="Gateway_ManufacturingSplit" targetRef="Task_ManufactureOtherParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P5" sourceRef="Gateway_BarChoice" targetRef="Task_ManufactureVodkaBar">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">barType = 'vodka'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P6" sourceRef="Gateway_BarChoice" targetRef="Task_ManufactureWhiskeyBar">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">barType = 'whiskey'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P7" sourceRef="Gateway_BarChoice" targetRef="Task_ManufactureOtherBar"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P8" sourceRef="Task_ManufactureVodkaBar" targetRef="Gateway_BarMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P9" sourceRef="Task_ManufactureWhiskeyBar" targetRef="Gateway_BarMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P10" sourceRef="Task_ManufactureOtherBar" targetRef="Gateway_BarMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P11" sourceRef="Gateway_BarMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ManufacturingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P12" sourceRef="Task_ManufactureOtherParts" targetRef="Gateway_ManufacturingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P13" sourceRef="Gateway_ManufacturingJoin" targetRef="Task_AssembleInterior"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P14" sourceRef="Task_AssembleInterior" targetRef="Gateway_TestSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P15" sourceRef="Gateway_TestSplit" targetRef="Task_ConductTestFlight"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P16" sourceRef="Gateway_TestSplit" targetRef="Task_CreateTestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P17" sourceRef="Task_ConductTestFlight" targetRef="Gateway_TestJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P18" sourceRef="Task_CreateTestProtocol" targetRef="Gateway_ProtocolSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P19" sourceRef="Gateway_ProtocolSplit" targetRef="Task_ProvideProtocolToProducer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P20" sourceRef="Gateway_ProtocolSplit" targetRef="Task_SendTestProtocolToCustomer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P21" sourceRef="Task_ProvideProtocolToProducer" targetRef="Gateway_ProtocolJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P22" sourceRef="Task_SendTestProtocolToCustomer" targetRef="Gateway_ProtocolJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P23" sourceRef="Gateway_ProtocolJoin" targetRef="Gateway_TestJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P24" sourceRef="Gateway_TestJoin" targetRef="Task_DeliverAirplane"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P25" sourceRef="Task_DeliverAirplane" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P26" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" targetRef="End_ProductionComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Configure and receive luxury airplane" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Customer">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Customer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ChooseSpecifications</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendSpecifications</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveTestProtocol</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveAirplane</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Customer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Customer" name="Begin airplane configuration">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChooseSpecifications" name="Choose one of five bars, seat count, color, and toilet water amount">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSpecifications" name="Send specifications to producer" messageRef="Message_Specifications">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveTestProtocol" name="Receive test protocol" messageRef="Message_TestProtocol">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveAirplane" name="Receive delivered airplane" messageRef="Message_DeliveredAirplane">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Confirm delivery" messageRef="Message_DeliveryConfirmation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Customer" name="Delivery confirmed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C6</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C1" sourceRef="Start_Customer" targetRef="Task_ChooseSpecifications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C2" sourceRef="Task_ChooseSpecifications" targetRef="Task_SendSpecifications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C3" sourceRef="Task_SendSpecifications" targetRef="Task_ReceiveTestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C4" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveTestProtocol" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAirplane"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C5" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveAirplane" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C6" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="End_Customer"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
